1. One-Paragraph “Why This Works” Explainer (Canonical)

Why MetaBlooms Works
MetaBlooms succeeds because it freezes the rules of learning while allowing the state of knowledge to change continuously. Its core never rewrites how trust, evidence, or outcomes are evaluated; instead, it applies those invariant rules to new signals, predictions, and results over time. This separation prevents drift, preserves comparability
